messages:
Lucy Park: Hi all 1 I'm Lucy, starting today on Systems (GMT+1). Super excited! Quick housekeeping: I dont seem to have org Slack access yet and my laptop shipping says delayed. Who should I ping for temporary creds?
Nikhil Rao: Welcome Lucy :tada: Im Nikhil, your manager. 1:1 scheduled for 4pm your time. For temporary access, @IT Helpdesk usually creates a short-lived account; @Aaron W. will pair with you for the first week.
Zoe (People Ops): Hi Lucy :wave: I sent onboarding emails this morning. If Slack invite didn't arrive check spam or the email you used to sign up. Also do the payroll form: https://redwood.example/payroll-form.
Lucy Park: Thanks! My signup email is lucy.park@gmail.com. I checked spam and nothing. Also curious about sticker requests 1 Im a big sticker nerd.
DevEx Bot: New-hire checklist created for Lucy Park 2 tasks: SSO, MDM, security training, channel joins (#systems, #oncall-ops).
IT Helpdesk: Hi Lucy 1 we see your laptop shipping delayed to tomorrow. For temp access run: ```ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 lucy_temp@bastion.redwood.internal``` Password DM'd. We'll add you to the "systems-read" S3 role by EOD.
Aaron W.: Hey Lucy :wave: Im Aaron, Systems engineer and your buddy this week. Ill ping you DM with a runbook walkthrough slot. Fun fact: I have a small collection of transit tokens from different cities.
Lucy Park: Love transit tokens! Fun fact about me: I knit tiny hats for succulents (ask me later :seedling:). Also I just accepted the Slack invite that Zoe resent. Logged in and joined #new-hires.
Nikhil Rao: Great. @Aaron can you add Lucy to the sprint board and give a quick tour of our deploy process tomorrow morning?
Aaron W.: Yep, adding Lucy to the board now and scheduling a 30-min sync.
Zoe (People Ops): Lucy 1 I emailed badge pickup instructions and the MDM enrollment link. If MDM shows "device not compliant" after enrollment, reply here and we'll escalate.
Lucy Park: Enrolled in MDM and device shows up in the portal. Thanks for the quick turnaround everyone. One last tiny ask: who curates the Slack emoji pack? I want to add a tiny-succulent sticker :grin:
Aaron W.: That's usually DevEx but I can add it for you this afternoon. Welcome to the team, Lucy :tada:
Lucy Park: Thanks everyone 1 really appreciate the warm welcome. Looking forward to the 1:1 and pairing tomorrow.
